notes:
Setup installs and updates itself; portable runs from any folder without installing.

Changes since v0.3.47:
- Poll speed part 2: Razer, Aula and Ajazz read outside the HID lock; 0.3.48
- Poll speed: device I/O no longer holds the shared HID lock (part 1)
- Dead code: two unused strings, five exports used only in their own file
- Security: rustls 0.23.46, no zip extractor, pinned actions, read-only tokens
- Translations for 0.3.48: trust, overlay, smart plug, health, charge phase, game drain, HUD
- Release notes from the commits since the previous tag
- Always-on-top mini HUD with adjustable opacity
- Per-game drain: learned while each game runs, used before its matches
- Charge phase: pace, time to full, and fast vs trickle while charging
- Battery health: when capacity is expected to fall below 80%
- Smart plug webhook: a JSON POST at 80% or a full charge
- Stream overlay: GET /overlay, a widget for an OBS browser source
- Trust badge: proven, unproven, standard or taught, on every reading
- Logitech G735 headset: battery from HID++ UnifiedBattery
